newsitem.title: UK: General Nutrition eyes Holland - paper.
newsitem.headline: General Nutrition eyes Holland - paper.

text.p: The United States' General Nutrition Companies Inc may bid for Holland & Barrett if the British health chain is put up for sale by the victor in the battle for Lloyds Chemists Plc, the Independent on Sunday reported.
Lloyds, which owns Holland & Barrett, is a takeover target by Britain's UniChem Plc. Germany's Gehe AG is also evaluating a possible bid.
The newspaper reported that General Nutrition was set to open the first of 400 planned stores in Britain.

"Sources at its Pittsburgh headquarters said it was still committed to the plans, but confirmed it had held extenstive talks with Lloyds before and would not rule out a bid," the Independent on Sunday reported.
A spokesman for General Nutrition was not immediately available for comment in Pittsburgh.
